newsitem.title: UK: UK shares climb with Dow, bid rumours resurface.
newsitem.headline: UK shares climb with Dow, bid rumours resurface.

text.p: London shares ended firmer on Thursday, buoyed by the return of bid speculation in drugs group Zeneca but after a session largely dominated by U.S. events.
The FTSE 100 index finished up 17.7 points at 4,042.1, towards the top of the day's trading range. Advancers led decliners by roughly five-to-four.
UK shares started firmer on the back of the Dow's resurgence but remained tentative ahead of an onslaught of U.S. economic data later in the day.
But Wall Street stocks rallied from record levels after the data supported the view that the economy was slowing.
